title: PyCORN: UNICORN data in your browser

translation.note: This translation is by machine. Table and column names, warnings and the downloaded files stay in English, and some technical messages may still appear in English.
status.downloading: Downloading Python and its packages (about 15 MB, usually only the first time; needs the internet)...
